authority: This file defines the canonical static-analysis, compiler-warning, and suppression disposition for every active STRling ecosystem. toolchain.json remains authoritative for executable versions and commands.

inventory_groups.reason: Import-order exceptions support explicit path bootstrapping or re-exports; type-checker directives predate a governed Python type checker and must not expand.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Keep only narrowly coded import/re-export exceptions and retire broad type ignores as a governed Python type checker is introduced.

inventory_groups.reason: Three @ts-ignore directives exercise assumptions that the public Pattern value is callable; changing the product contract is outside this hardgate task.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Resolve the callable-Pattern contract in contained product work, then replace or remove all three directives.

inventory_groups.reason: Allow attributes cover unused imports and dead code and require individual review under strict rustc or Clippy.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Remove attributes proven unnecessary; separately govern any attribute whose removal exposes semantic work.

inventory_groups.reason: Four C setup directives permit intentional package-list word splitting; three directives belong to the upstream Gradle wrapper portability implementation.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Retain only while the exact setup expansion and repository-managed Gradle wrapper remain; re-audit when either script changes.
